name: AIxCrypto Holdings Inc.
summary: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to discovering and developing innovative treatments for both adult and pediatric oncology. Its leading investigational therapeutic, QN-302, is a small molecule G-quadruplexes (G4)-selective transcription inhibitor currently progressing through Phase I clinical trials for pancreatic cancer and a range of other solid tumors. The firm is also advancing Pan-RAS, a preclinical-stage program targeting advanced solid tumors. Founded in 1996 and headquartered in Carlsbad, California, the company rebranded from Qualigen Therapeutics, Inc. to AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc. in November 2025.
